figures.caption: Figure 1. Summary of cell production. (a) Illustration of Ag deposi- tion via sputtering; (b) illustration of the SSB full-cell arrangement; (c) illustration of the three-electrode arrangement; (d) BSE cross- section images of the sputtered C-Cu current collector after compres- sion at 500 MPa; and (e–g) corresponding EDS maps for Cu, C, and Ag, respectively.

Figure 2. Cycling of full cells with C-Cu, Ag Cu, and Ag C-Cu interlayers at 60 °C, 4 MPa stack pressure, and 1 mA/cm2 charge/discharge current. Voltage/capacity of (a) C-Cu and (b) Ag Cu during ﬁrst, second, ﬁfth, and tenth cycles; (c) voltage/capacity during the ﬁrst charge/discharge cycle of C-Cu and Ag C-Cu interlayers; (d) voltage/capacity of Ag C-Cu during ﬁrst, second, ﬁfth, and tenth cycles; (e) charge capacity of Ag C-Cu inter- layers over 100 cycles; and (f) Coulombic eﬃciency of Ag C-Cu interlayers over 100 cycles. The insets show the (a) C-Cu, (b) Ag Cu, and (d) Ag C- Cu (100 nm) current collectors.

Figure 3. Single charge of three-electrode cells using diﬀerent current collectors and cross-section of an Ag C-Cu (100 nm) current collector, a deposited layer, and LPS separator region after a single charge at 2 mA/cm2. (a) Single charge of stainless steel, Cu, C-Cu, and Ag C-Cu at 1 mA/cm2 for 1 h; (b) single charge of C-Cu and Ag C-Cu at 2 mA/cm2 for 2.5 h; (c) SEM image of Ag C-Cu after a single charge at 2 mA/cm2; (d–g) EDS maps of Cu, S, C, and Ag, respectively; (h) SEM low magniﬁcation image of Ag C-Cu; (i) EDS line scan spectrum obtained from the line marked in (j); (j) magniﬁed SEM image of Ag C-Cu.

Figure 4. Charging response of three-electrode cells with an Ag C-Cu (100 nm) interlayer at 2 mA/cm2 for 2.5 h and discharge at 1 mA/cm2 and a cross-section of the Ag C-Cu current collector, stripped layer, and LPS separator region after charge/discharge. (a) Voltage window between 0 and 5 V vs Li+/Li; (b) magniﬁed voltage window of (a), between –50 and 50 mV vs Li+/Li (OCV = open-circuit voltage); (c) SEM image of Ag C-Cu after discharge; (d–g) EDS maps of Cu, S, C, and Ag, respectively; (h) EDS line scan spectrum obtained from the line marked in (i); (i) SEM image of Ag C-Cu after discharge.
Figure 5. Schematic and idealized illustration of the preparation of the Ag C-Cu interlayer and suggested preferential Li plating and stripping upon charging and discharging.
